responsibility: Defines the GNU/Linux uClinux ELF OS personality for LM32 by overriding the generic ELF target specs. It sets C++ and OS preprocessor behavior, chooses the C library and libgcc link specs, selects Linux crt startup and termination files, provides the dynamic-linker and shared/static link rules, adjusts the link-group sequencing, and forces PIC by default unless disabled. This file is responsible for integrating the LM32 code generator with the Linux userland ABI and toolchain startup/link conventions.
